name: signlocal-extension
description: signlocal browser extension: the bridge between pages using @signlocal/sdk and the signlocal app (native messaging). No UI besides the toolbar popup.

scripts.build: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b edge && wxt build -b firefox --mv3 && wxt build -b safari
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b edge && wxt zip -b firefox --mv3 && wxt zip -b safari
scripts.zip:store: SIGNLOCAL_CHANNEL=store wxt zip -b chrome && SIGNLOCAL_CHANNEL=store wxt zip -b edge && SIGNLOCAL_CHANNEL=store wxt zip -b firefox --mv3
